researchExperiences.title: Graduate Researcher — Fe-Ni Sulfide Electrocatalysts (DFT, MLIP & MD)
researchExperiences.organization: The Pennsylvania State University (Advisor: Dr. Nelson Y. Dzade)
bullets: Performed spin-polarized DFT and AIMD simulations for adsorption free energies, surface stability, and electronic structure modulation across 30+ active sites to derive kinetics-informed HER/OER mechanisms.
Fine-tuned equivariant foundation and magnetic MLIPs (OC25 eSEN and Magnetic MACE/mMACE) to run GPU-accelerated classical MD and capture explicit interfacial solvation effects.

researchExperiences.title: Graduate Researcher — SrNb2O6 Photocatalysts & Multi-MLIP Screening
researchExperiences.organization: The Pennsylvania State University (Advisor: Dr. Nelson Y. Dzade)
bullets: Engineered doped oxide catalysts for band-gap optimization; executed DFT across 100+ active site combinations, elucidating 11 reaction mechanisms and transition state structures.
Built high-throughput MLIP screening & MD workflows with committee uncertainty quantification to guide explicit solvation studies and automate VASP validation.
